$comment: Red-line breaches that a check found in existing code and that need a decision before they can be fixed. Not exceptions: red lines have none. PRINCIPLES.md (Migration): code that breaks a red line is fixed before the next release, so this list must be empty on main (tests/red-lines.test.js fails there otherwise). Each entry is matched against the offender text of one check; never add an entry to hide a new breach.
